project_info.theme: Lashe Superfood anti-acne cleanser tropical product hero

main_subject.detail: A single white tube of 'LASHE superfood JELLY FACIAL WASH Oil Removal & Anti-Acne' stands inside a yellow-and-white inflatable ring on a sunny beach. The headline reads 'SUA RUA MAT DANG THACH SACH SAU, GIAM MUN'. A blue three-part claim strip says 'CHIET XUAT XUONG RONG & RAU MA', 'CONG NGHE BAO BOC DHA', and 'AN TOAN CHO DA NHAY CAM'. The tube label also includes 'Encapsulated BHA & Niacinamide' and 'Cactus & Centella'.
main_subject.style: Bright tropical skincare poster with clean product render, cheerful beach props, and claim-driven ecommerce composition
